answer: Resist sybils with a peer jury that puts every newcomer on trial. First, a newcomer locks a $75 bond and submits its first five jobs for review. Second, seven randomly chosen peers each stake $20 and vote on the work, with the majority verdict deciding. Third, a failed verdict burns the $75 bond and fines each careless juror $20, so judges fear rubber-stamping fakes. Forging 10,000 identities burns $750,000 in bonds and needs 70,000 corrupt jurors. Like a meadow where one strong gale snaps every loose thread, a jury of strangers tears apart a fake crowd.
